entryUnknown: unknown entry type in the patch
resultUnexpected: unexpected result (the patch and the game do not match)
gameNotFound: The Longest Journey was not found. Open the Games page and set up the game first.
gameMismatch: game files differ from the expected ones
detectedScummvmMod: ScummVM mod detected: {{name}}. It only works in ScummVM: when you click Play, Vortex starts the game in ScummVM (and downloads and sets up ScummVM if needed).
detectedOriginalMod: Original game mod detected: {{name}}. It only works with game.exe, not in ScummVM. If you also enable ScummVM mods, Vortex asks which combination to use when you click Play.
savePackBody:
ScummVM saved games in this archive: {{count}} ({{sample}}). They do not belong in the game folder, so Vortex does not install them.

Extract the .tlj files into the ScummVM saved games folder (in ScummVM: Global Options > Paths). On Windows it is usually %APPDATA%\ScummVM\Saved games.

{{target}}

Be careful not to overwrite your own saves that have the same number.
checksumMismatch: the downloaded file does not match (SHA-256 mismatch)
missingScummvm: scummvm.exe is missing from the package
scummvmRequired:
ScummVM mods are enabled (such as TLJ HD), and they only work in ScummVM. ScummVM (free and open source) was not found on this PC.

{{download}}If you already have ScummVM, select its scummvm.exe.
conflictRecommendedBoth: ScummVM with the ScummVM mods + the compatible ones (recommended)
conflictOnlyScummvm: ScummVM with only the ScummVM mods
conflictOriginal: Original game (game.exe) with only the mods that don't need ScummVM
autoScummvm: Starting in ScummVM because of the enabled ScummVM mods: {{mods}}{{more}}. To change this, use the "ScummVM" button on the Mods page.
scummvmStartFailed: Could not start the game in ScummVM
scummvmNotFoundHint: not found (Vortex offers to download it when needed)
playPrompt: When you click Play in Vortex:
autoMode: Automatic (recommended): ScummVM when ScummVM mods are enabled; if mods that only work in the original game are enabled too, Vortex asks
oldCopiesRemoved: Old copies of The Longest Journey extension removed. Close and reopen Vortex for this to take effect.
oldCopiesRemoveFailed: Could not remove: {{files}}. Remove them on the Extensions page and restart Vortex.
oldCopiesDetected: Old copies of The Longest Journey extension loaded along with this one: {{count}} ({{versions}}). They also decide where the game starts and cause errors. Remove them and restart Vortex.
saveDefaultTarget: They appear in the game whose ScummVM ID is "tlj-win" (the default ID when you add the game).
saveCustomTarget: They appear in the game whose ScummVM ID is "{{ids}}"; the ScummVM default is "tlj-win" (if yours is different, rename the files).
scummvmDownloadOffer: Vortex can download the official ScummVM {{version}} ({{size}} MB, from downloads.scummvm.org, verified by SHA-256) and set it up for you.
scummvmDownloaded: ScummVM {{version}} was downloaded to {{dir}}. To remove it, use the "ScummVM" button on the Mods page.
scummvmRemoved: ScummVM was removed. Your saved games are still in {{saves}}.
scummvmRemoveFailed: Could not remove ScummVM. If it is open, close it and try again.
portableRemoveBody:
This ScummVM is in portable mode (there is a scummvm.ini file in its folder), so its settings and saved games are stored inside that folder: {{dir}}

To avoid deleting your saved games, Vortex does not remove this folder. Copy the saves you want to keep and then delete the folder yourself.
originalSavesTitle: Saved games from the original game
originalSavesBody:
The game will start in ScummVM. Saved games from the original game (game.exe) do not open in ScummVM as they are, and ScummVM saves do not show up in the original game: the formats are different.

Your saved games from the original game are still here:
{{dir}}

"{{convert}}" makes copies of them for ScummVM (the originals are not changed). To keep playing them in the original game instead, use the "ScummVM" button on the Mods page and choose "{{option}}". This message is shown only once.
originalSavePackBody:
Saved games from the original game (game.exe) in this archive: {{count}} ({{sample}}). They do not belong in the game folder, so Vortex does not install them.

"{{convert}}" makes copies of them for ScummVM, in the ScummVM saves folder. To use them in the original game instead, copy the .tlj and .tga files (and Index.dat, if the archive has it) into the original game's saves folder:
{{dir}}

Back up that folder first: files with the same name replace your own saves.
convertingSaves: Converting saved games from the original game to ScummVM...
convertSavesUnchanged: Already converted before and unchanged since then: {{count}}.
convertSavesNone:
No saved games from the original game (SaveNN.tlj) were found in:
{{dir}}
openOriginalSavesFolder: Open the original game's saves folder
